# Pre

::: {.callout-note}
The `uv` python interpreter lives in `~/minstallation/.venvs/KKIK_parse/bin/python`
:::

```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import session_info
```

Figure settings:

```{python}
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = "Nimbus sans"
```

Random settings:

```{python}
random_state = 275
```

Create folders for outputs:

```{python}
resdir = "1_normalization/outputs/files"
os.makedirs(resdir,exist_ok=True)
```

Read object from previous step:

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad("0_QC/outputs/files/sc.h5ad")
```


# Normalization

Save counts in layer counts:
```{python}
adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()
```

Log normalize with median as scaling factor (default) and save in layer.

```{python}
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=None)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.layers["lognorm"] = adata.X.copy()
```

# Highly variable genes

Selection using `seurat` method with `sample` as batch.
```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, layer="lognorm", batch_key="sample")
sc.pl.highly_variable_genes(adata, show=True)
```

# Dimensional reduction

## PCA


```{python}
sc.pp.pca(adata,mask_var="highly_variable",)
```

### Plot cells in PCA space


```{python}
sc.pl.pca(
    adata,
    color=["sample"],
    cmap="magma",
)
sc.pl.pca(
    adata,
    color=["log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts","qc_status"],
    cmap="magma",
)


sc.pl.pca_loadings(adata)
```

## UMAP

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(adata)
sc.tl.umap(adata,random_state=random_state)
```

### Plot cells in UMAP space

#### QC
```{python}
sc.pl.umap(adata, color="sample")
sc.pl.umap(
    adata,
    color=["log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts", "qc_status"],
    cmap="magma",
)
```

#### Specific genes

# Remove flagged cells

The flagged low quality cells occupy the same space in UMAP and they show a shape that indicates their low quality. I will remove for further analyses. 

Cells before filtering: `{python} adata.n_obs`

```{python}
adata = adata[adata.obs["qc_status"] == "pass"].copy()
```

Cells after filtering: `{python} adata.n_obs`

# Repeat dimensional reduction 

Re-normalize and select HVGs.

```{python}
adata.X = adata.layers["counts"].copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=None)
adata.uns.pop("log1p", None)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.layers["lognorm"] = adata.X.copy()
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, layer="lognorm", batch_key="sample")
sc.pl.highly_variable_genes(adata, show=True)

sc.pp.pca(
    adata,
    mask_var="highly_variable",
)
```

Sanity check: the max of counts should be an integer, and logcounts is probably not integer:

- counts: `{python} adata.layers["counts"].max()`
- logcounts: `{python} adata.layers["lognorm"].max()`

### Plot cells in PCA space


```{python}
sc.pl.pca(
    adata,
    color=["sample"],
    cmap="magma",
)
sc.pl.pca(
    adata,
    color=["log1p_total_counts", "log1p_n_genes_by_counts","qc_status"],
    cmap="magma",
)


sc.pl.pca_loadings(adata)
```

